summary: PaulRBerg 提交 EIP-8123，新增 eth_txLimitGasCap 方法，用于查询 EIP-7825 的单笔交易 gas 上限。Madeindreams 发起预草案讨论，主张让钱包与 dApp 之间的连接器与 SDK 中介显式可见。0x_WeakSheep 指出 mev-boost 不惩罚不交付的 relay，验证者会等约 4 秒再回退。

summary_en: PaulRBerg submitted EIP-8123, adding eth_txLimitGasCap to query the EIP-7825 per transaction gas cap. Madeindreams opened a pre draft discussion on making connector and SDK mediation between wallets and dApps explicit. 0x_WeakSheep noted mev-boost does not penalize relays that fail to deliver, so validators wait about 4 seconds before falling back.
